set-variable.name: tcBody
set-variable.value: @{ try { return context.Request.Body?.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true) ?? new JObject(); } catch { return new JObject(); } }

set-variable.name: tcModel
set-variable.value: @{ var b = ((JObject)context.Variables["tcBody"]); var d = context.Request.MatchedParameters.GetValueOrDefault("deployment-id", ""); var m = ""; if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(d)) { m = d; } else { m = (string)(b["model"] as JValue); } return m ?? ""; }

set-variable.name: tcMaxTokens
set-variable.value: @{ var b = ((JObject)context.Variables["tcBody"]); var t = (b["max_completion_tokens"] ?? b["max_tokens"]) as JValue; return t == null ? "" : (string)t; }

set-variable.name: tcAnswer
set-variable.value: @{ var r = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("tcAdmit"); if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return new JObject(); } try { return r.Body.As<JObject>() ?? new JObject(); } catch { return new JObject(); } }

set-variable.name: tcSeenFailMode
set-variable.value: @{ var r = (IResponse)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("tcAdmit"); if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return ""; } var m = r.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-tc-fail-mode", ""); return m == "open" || m == "closed" ? m : ""; }

when.condition: @(((string)context.Variables["tcDecision"]) == "refuse" && ((string)(((JObject)context.Variables["tcAnswer"])["reason"] as JValue) == "check_unavailable" || (string)(((JObject)context.Variables["tcAnswer"])["reason"] as JValue) == "invalid_request") && (string)(((JObject)context.Variables["tcAnswer"])["retry_after_seconds"] as JValue) != null)

when.set-body: @{ var b = ((JObject)context.Variables["tcBody"]); b["model"] = (string)(((JObject)context.Variables["tcAnswer"])["model"] as JValue); return b.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None); }

set-variable.name: tcCacheTtl
set-variable.value: @{ var a = (JObject)context.Variables["tcAnswer"]; var ttl = a["cache_ttl_seconds"] as JValue; var held = a["reservation_cents"] as JValue; if (ttl == null || held == null || a["degraded"] != null || a["fail_mode_known"] != null) { return 0; } var t = (int)ttl; return t > 0 && (double)held == 0 ? t : 0; }
